messages:
alex: planning maintenance in apac-south1 — NVMe controller firmware + GPU BIOS micro-updates + graceful kube node reboots. Window: Sun Nov 12 22:00-02:00 UTC (overnight APAC local). We want minimal disruption for low-latency routes. Main ask: confirm excluded pools and cache strategy.
ravi: please exclude `reserved-gpu` and `enterprise-dedicated` pools. those customers have strict SLAs.
beth: +1. also tie the change to a small canary group (2 racks) before broad rollout.
alex: canary racking is the plan: r1 -> wait 20m -> r2 -> wait 30m -> rest in waves of 3 racks with 12m gaps.
ops-bot: calendar event created: "apac-south1 NVMe + GPU BIOS (staggered waves)" Sun Nov 12 22:00 UTC — owners: alex, ravi.
ravi: KV cache warming: last round saw a p99 spike after reboots. propose preseed of model cache + prefix cache on standby hosts and run synthetic load for 15m post-canary.
beth: synthetic probes should mimic 95th percentile seq lengths, not just small requests. otherwise we miss tail effects.
alex: agree. we'll use `synthetic-generator --seqdist 95p --qps 500` pointed at primed nodes.
cost-ops: heads up on costs: synthetic preseed + cross-region spill if needed could be around ~$4.5k. we should estimate upper bound and tag.
alex: understood — we'll add cost tag `maint:apac-nvme-nov12`. prefer to avoid cross-region if routing tweaks suffice.
ravi: routing tweak: temporarily reduce weight for large-batch routes and increase weights for low-latency route group by 30%. That should funnel latency-sensitive traffic to healthy hosts.
beth: add admission control to reject new large-batch sessions once a rack enters reboot state — simplest way to reduce noisy neighbor risk.
alex: doing admission cap = 400 for `batch` class during window.
ops-bot: preflight checklist scheduled 60m before start.
support-team: we'll prepare a short customer advisory for hosted customers in apac-south1. dedicated customers excluded but we'll still ping them.
beth: rollback criteria: if p95 latency rises > 250ms for 10m OR error rate > 1.5% sustained for 5m, abort and rejoin nodes. adding manual gate after first two rack waves.
alex: adding automated rollback hook + manual 2-person confirm (ravi + beth) before continuing after canary.
cost-ops: if we do cross-region burst, allocate to project `infra-maint-nov` and include expected SKU list (egress, spot uplift).
ravi: one technical note: NVMe firmware updates can cause short PCI bus reset traces. ensure kernel logs captured and we have a bmc-serial capture available.
beth: will enable serial logging and upload to s3://internal-maint-logs/apac-nov12 if we hit non-trivial errors.
alex: final plan updated in runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/apac-south1-nvme-bios-nov12.md — sections: canary, preseed, probes, rollback, contacts. please review.
ops-bot: reminder set 1h and 10m preflight.
ravi: lgtm from infra.
beth: lgtm from platform.
support-team: outbound advisory drafted, will send 24h notice to affected hosted customers and a 2h reminder.
alex: thanks all. will post preflight output 50m before start. :rocket:
